incident: Inventory API slow causes checkout timeouts
symptoms: checkout failures correlated with inventory calls
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: Inventory API experienced a slow query after a data growth threshold.
resolution: Checkout was healthy; its dependency on inventory was slow because of a query regression. Fixing the dependency query removed checkout timeouts.
postmortem: Checkout scaling did not reduce dependency latency.
